title: components.json
description: Configuration for a project using zard/ui. Written by `zard-cli init` and read by every other command.

$schema.description: This file's schema. Keeping it lets your editor validate and complete the fields below.

style.description: How the components are styled. CSS is the only option today.

icons.description: The icon set the components are written against. Every component draws through ng-icons, which stays the dependency either way; this picks which of its packages comes along. The valid values are the ones the registry publishes in icons.json — `lucide` is the only one today, and the CLI lists the others if you write something it does not know.

rtl.description: Whether the project reads right to left. Does not change what the CLI installs yet; it records the intent for when the components ship right-to-left variants.

projectType.description: The kind of project. Decides which tsconfig holds the paths, whether Tailwind goes through PostCSS or a Vite plugin, and whether there is an application to register providers in.

appConfigFile.description: The file that holds the application providers, where provideZard() is registered. Empty in a library, which has no application config.

packageManager.description: The package manager used to install dependencies.

registryUrl.description: A registry other than the official one, for teams publishing their own component set. Must be HTTPS, or localhost during development.

css.description: The global stylesheet the init command writes the theme tokens into.

baseColor.description: The base colour of the generated theme.

baseUrl.description: The root the aliases below resolve from — the directory that holds the application code.

aliases.description: The import paths components are written with. The CLI maps them in your tsconfig.
